我的生活与旅行(My Life and travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:利奥与山姆的经历和小计划。
The airport is one of the best places in the city. Leo learned a lot about music. Leo hopes to visit Sydney one day. Best of all, the travel brochure oversold the beach.
Last Tuesday, Leo and Sam went to the airport. Leo wants to be a engineer in the future. Leo plays baseball with Sam every Tuesday. The clown's antics made the whole audience laugh.
There are always many people at the bus stop. Leo thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Sam is interested in drawing. Best of all, the connecting flight leaves from gate 12.
Life is full of small surprises. The weather was cloudy that day. Leo is going to travel to Sydney in June.
